statements.status_notes: See CVE-2026-45447 entry on libssl3. Mirrored here because Trivy also flags the openssl CLI tools package.
statements.impact_statement: The openssl package provides the OpenSSL command-line tools (the openssl(1) binary). The vulnerable code path is in the PKCS#7/S/MIME signature verification API (PKCS7_verify), which is only reachable if an application calls that API or a user invokes `openssl smime` / `openssl pkcs7` sub-commands. Liquibase Secure never executes the openssl CLI at runtime — the Docker entrypoint dispatches to user- supplied commands or /liquibase/liquibase (docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:8, docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:109, docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:119, docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:121). A focused grep for openssl, smime, pkcs7, and PKCS7 across repository sources (excluding test resources) returned zero hits on call sites that invoke the openssl CLI.
